about: The introitus of the formulary “2nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord has become my protector, and He has brought me out into a broad place; He has saved me, because He was pleased with me. I will love You, O Lord, my strength: the Lord is my firm support, and my refuge, and my deliverer. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. The Lord has become my protector, and He has brought me out into a broad place; He has saved me, because He was pleased with me.
